name: homedesign-site
description: חנות מותאמת (אפשרות ג'): אתר, מנוע חדר, Worker API ו-D1

scripts.prepare:data: npm run catalog && npm run assets:temp && npm run assets:supplier
scripts.dev: npm run prepare:data && npm run db:reset -w @hd/api && concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @hd/api" "npm run dev -w @hd/web"
scripts.build: npm run prepare:data && npm run build -w @hd/web && npm run build -w @hd/api && npm run budget
scripts.preview: npm run db:reset -w @hd/api && npm run preview -w @hd/api
scripts.preview:artifact: npm run prepare:data && npm run build:artifact -w @hd/web && tsx tools/finalize-artifact.ts && tsx tools/check-artifact.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e && npm run a11y
